title: Scalar Products from a Figure
body: Vectors are given by their magnitudes and directions from the $$+x$$ axis (horizontal right): $$A=10.0$$ at 150°, $$B=5.0$$ at 127°, $$C=12.0$$ at 300°, $$D=20.0$$ at 217°, $$F=20.0$$ at 240°. Find the following scalar products: (a) $$\vec{A}\cdot\vec{C}, $$ (b) $$\vec{A}\cdot\vec{F}, $$ (c) $$\vec{D}\cdot\vec{C}, $$ (d) $$\vec{A}\cdot(\vec{F}+2\vec{C}),$$ (e) $$\hat{i}\cdot\vec{B}, $$ (f) $$\hat{j}\cdot\vec{B}, $$ (g) $$(3\hat{i}-\hat{j})\cdot\vec{B}, $$ (h) $$\vec{B}\cdot\vec{B}$$.
